weaknesses.title: SYS NUM zero is falsey — env BATCH=0 silent no-op if gated wrong
weaknesses.detail: After SYS ENV then SYS NUM, LAST_N==0 is a valid TAKE window (process nothing) but common agent patterns IF LAST_N > 0 THEN LET BATCH = LAST_N never apply zero. Env CUBALC_QUEUE_BATCH=0 was ignored and default BATCH=8 ran. Zero-valid numeric configs need IF OK == 1 only, not LAST_N > 0 post-NUM.
weaknesses.repro: Without fix: BATCH=0 REQUIRE=1 still accepted jobs (default 8). With LET BATCH = LAST_N on OK==1 only: TAKE 0 → EXIT 2.

weaknesses.title: UNIQ is adjacent-only; SORT is pure lexicographic
weaknesses.detail: SYS UNIQ without prior SORT leaves non-adjacent duplicates (b\na\nb → 3 fields). SORT is byte lexicographic — job10 sorts before job2 (job1, job10, job2). Real job queues often need natural/version sort or full unique set ops.
weaknesses.repro:
SYS UNIQ b
a
b → LAST_N=3; SORT then UNIQ → 2. SORT job10
job2
job1 → job1,job10,job2.

weaknesses.title: SPLIT keeps empty fields; allowlist GREP is substring not exact
weaknesses.detail: SYS SPLIT ',' '.bits,,.json' → 3 fields with empty middle. Allowlist check via SYS GREP ext allow_fields is substring over newline fields — works for .bits but can false-positive if one ext is prefix of another (e.g. .j vs .json). No exact-line match form.
weaknesses.repro: SPLIT consecutive commas; GREP '.j' against '.json\n.job' matches both.

weaknesses.title: SYS JOIN still missing from forms/search
weaknesses.detail: Queue paths require SYS JOIN STATE queue but search JOIN / forms JOIN still n=0. SORT/TAKE/SPLIT are cataloged; JOIN is not.

weaknesses.title: var_slot 64-cap DECIDE still requires early pre-bind
weaknesses.detail: Carry-over: batch walks still inflate n_vars; LET DECIDE=-1 at boot still required for dig capture after FOLDBITS path.
weaknesses.repro: Remove pre-bind LET DECIDE=-1 from queue_batch_worker; dig may stick at -1/0 despite decide N print.

Know SYS JOIN from programs, not forms catalog
